title: Incomplete validation of external ad-reply URLs in WhatsApp for Android and WhatsApp Business for Android before…
description: A vulnerability in WhatsApp for Android and WhatsApp Business for Android before version 2.26.17.4 involves incomplete validation of external ad-reply URLs. This flaw could allow an attacker to cause a target device to reveal its IP information by sending media from an attacker-controlled URL within a crafted Click to WhatsApp ad-reply message. The issue may have been exploited alongside specific spam messages. The CVSS score is 3.5, indicating a low severity impact.
